scope: Document/source coverage; not a new browser test or production-completeness certification

requirements.title: Registration
requirements.expected: Create an account with a unique normalized email, password and accepted terms. Record the consent version and creation time; reject invalid or duplicate submissions without creating a partial profile.
requirements.evidence: No registration screen or verification flow.

requirements.title: Authentication
requirements.expected: Authenticate through Supabase Auth, establish a time-limited session and enforce the account role on every protected request. Display a generic failure for invalid credentials.
requirements.evidence: No sign-in screen or session UI.

requirements.title: Account recovery and logout
requirements.expected: Support an expiring password-reset link, invalidate revoked sessions and remove local access credentials on logout. Reauthentication is required for account deletion.
requirements.evidence: No recovery, reset, logout or expired-session flow.

requirements.title: Personal profile
requirements.expected: Create and edit dietary preferences, allergies, activity preferences, mobility constraints, preferred glucose unit and time zone. Validate fields and retain a profile version for recommendation reproducibility.
requirements.evidence: Profile editing exists; initial setup, profile version conflicts and changed-allergy plan warnings are absent.

requirements.title: Consent and data rights
requirements.expected: Let users grant or revoke health-import and optional image-retention consent, request an authenticated export, and delete their account and associated personal records. Record each request and outcome.
requirements.evidence: Image-retention toggle and local reset exist; purpose-specific consent, export and account deletion are absent.

requirements.title: real time analysis
requirements.expected: Accept a real time analysis up to the configured 10 MB limit. Check decoded format, dimensions and analyis validity; obtain camera permission and strip unnecessary metadata.
requirements.evidence: Camera is a fixture demo; permission, gallery validation, 10 MB checks and job states are absent.

requirements.title: Image suitability
requirements.expected: Check blur, exposure, visible item coverage and multiple-item ambiguity before inference. Return a specific recapture reason if the image does not satisfy the released capture criteria.
requirements.evidence: No blur, exposure, coverage or multiple-item recapture feedback.

requirements.title: Produce identification
requirements.expected: Identify only classes in the published model manifest. Store candidate label, confidence and model version; return unsupported or uncertain when validation-derived thresholds are not met.
requirements.evidence: Fixed Apple/97% fixture exists; supported-class, uncertain, unsupported and correction flows are absent.

requirements.title: Visual quality grading
requirements.expected: For an accepted produce class, grade visible ripeness, color, shape, surface condition and defects using a versioned class-specific rubric. Store evidence and confidence without claiming internal food safety.
requirements.evidence: No visual grade, feature evidence or versioned rubric view.

requirements.title: Reference price matching
requirements.expected: Match a verified observation by produce, market, date, currency, unit and compatible grade. Show a supported minimum–maximum range and source; suppress an unsupported grade premium or stale range.
requirements.evidence: No market/date/currency/unit/source-aware reference price view.

requirements.title: Nutrition lookup
requirements.expected: Retrieve the matched food-composition entry and display energy, carbohydrate, protein, fat and fiber with source and per-100-g basis. Clearly distinguish raw and prepared food entries.
requirements.evidence: Calories and daily macros exist; matched food form, fibre, per-100-g basis and catalog provenance are absent.

requirements.title: Portion and meal record
requirements.expected: Allow the user to confirm food identity and edible mass in grams before calculating portion nutrients and saving a meal. The camera alone shall not be treated as a weighing instrument.
requirements.evidence: Amount/grams/size and local save/draft work; confirmed identity, meal date/context and source version are absent.

requirements.title: Manual glucose recording
requirements.expected: Save a positive numeric reading with an explicit mg/dL or mmol/L unit, measurement time, context and source. Preserve the original value and unit alongside the normalized value.
requirements.evidence: No manual glucose entry.

requirements.title: Glucose history and visualization
requirements.expected: Display chronological readings, time range, units and source. Permit corrections to manual records and show missing-data gaps without presenting irregular samples as continuous monitoring.
requirements.evidence: No glucose chronology, visualization, range filtering or manual correction.

requirements.title: Health data connection
requirements.expected: Check device support, request narrowly scoped OS permission and import available glucose/activity records through an approved adapter. Manual entry shall remain available if the connection is declined.
requirements.evidence: Demo connection toggle exists; support and scoped permission review are absent.

requirements.title: Idempotent synchronization
requirements.expected: Deduplicate imported records by user, provider and external record ID. Process updates/deletions and checkpoint only after successful persistence; revoked permission stops further imports.
requirements.evidence: No sync status/counts/errors/revocation UI; real deduplication requires backend work.

requirements.title: Weekly diet guidance
requirements.expected: Produce seven dated days of food and portion suggestions from supported nutrition data, user preferences and available records. Exclude declared allergens and show the data window and rationale.
requirements.evidence: Seven day pills and meal fixtures exist; plan preparation, data window and constraints/rationale are absent.

requirements.title: Weekly activity guidance
requirements.expected: Produce activity suggestions compatible with recorded preferences and mobility constraints. Block or defer suggestions when the safety rule set requires professional assessment.
requirements.evidence: No weekly activity view or safety-deferral state.

requirements.title: Plan revision and feedback
requirements.expected: Allow acceptance, compatible substitutions, regeneration and adherence feedback. Save each plan version and preserve the inputs and rule/model versions that generated it.
requirements.evidence: Meal accept/substitute/feedback exist; activity revision, regeneration and version/conflict review are absent.

requirements.title: Footwear and prevention guidance
requirements.expected: Apply a versioned questionnaire rule set to footwear fit, comfort and reported mobility concerns. Return general prevention information or a referral message without diagnosing foot conditions.
requirements.evidence: No foot questionnaire or general guidance/referral view.

requirements.title: Conversational assistance
requirements.expected: Answer food, lifestyle and application questions using approved knowledge and minimum consented context. Separate source-grounded statements from unavailable information.
requirements.evidence: No assistant screen.

requirements.title: Conversation safety
requirements.expected: Screen requests and responses for diagnosis, prescribing, insulin-dose calculation and device-control instructions. Replace prohibited responses with a clear boundary and appropriate professional-help direction.
requirements.evidence: No conversation boundary, source-unavailable or provider-failure state.

requirements.title: Progress dashboard
requirements.expected: Combine recent meals, recorded glucose, plan adherence and last-sync state. Label absent data explicitly and make every summary traceable to the underlying records.
requirements.evidence: Meal/nutrition progress exists; recorded glucose, last sync and record links are absent.

requirements.title: History and correction
requirements.expected: Let users inspect saved analyses, meals, plans and their own feedback, correct supported fields and remove an image or record according to retention rules. Do not overwrite model evidence with a user correction.
requirements.evidence: Food scans and drafts exist; multi-type history, filters, supported corrections and removal are absent.

requirements.title: Price and nutrition curation
requirements.expected: Allow authorized curators to validate source, units, dates and class mappings before publishing market or nutrition records. Retain a review trail and support withdrawal of unreliable entries.
requirements.evidence: No curator queue or entry review.

requirements.title: Model and rule release
requirements.expected: Register the model manifest, dataset version, grading rubric, confidence thresholds and safety-rule version. Require review before activation and retain a rollback pointer.
requirements.evidence: No model/rule release review, activation or rollback view.

requirements.title: Role and ownership enforcement
requirements.expected: Restrict a user to their own personal records, a curator to catalog duties, and an administrator to approved operational actions. A staff role shall not imply unrestricted health-record access.
requirements.evidence: No staff workspaces or denied-access state; server authorization cannot be supplied by frontend UI.

requirements.title: Operational audit
requirements.expected: Write a redacted audit event for sign-in, data changes, catalog publication, model activation and denied access. Include actor, action, resource reference, time and request ID.
requirements.evidence: No redacted operational audit view.

requirements.title: Recoverable failures
requirements.expected: Show actionable errors for network loss, unsupported images, stale catalogs and provider failures. Bound retries and prevent duplicate meal, reading or plan creation on resubmission.
requirements.evidence: Some portion/profile validation exists; network, provider, stale data and pending/retry states are absent.
requirements.existingExtension: Recoverable states across existing and new screens

requirements.title: Source and uncertainty disclosure
requirements.expected: Display the model/rule version, source date and uncertainty relevant to each output. Withhold an authoritative-looking grade, price or personalized plan when prerequisites are missing.
requirements.evidence: Estimate wording exists; relevant source dates, model/rule versions and uncertainty are absent.

requirements.title: Notifications and preferences
requirements.expected: Let a user opt into meal, logging or plan reminders, set quiet hours and disable them. Notification previews shall omit glucose values and other sensitive health details by default.
requirements.evidence: No reminder preferences or permission/inactive states.

requirements.title: User reporting
requirements.expected: Accept feedback about a wrong food label, misleading price, unsuitable suggestion or chatbot answer. Route a redacted report to staff and expose its status to the reporting user.
requirements.evidence: Meal feedback is not an output-report flow; reporting/status/staff-resolution views are absent.

assistant: Missing approved sources and prohibited-request boundary
Minimum context consent and provider timeout
